{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Russia's transition to a market democracy is difficult.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Russian democracy is challenged by corruption that deeply penetrates Russian society.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Russia has its own self-interest and concerns that can and do run contrary to the interests of the United States.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States disagrees with what Russia is doing in Chechnya.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States remains concerned about signs of Russian efforts to intimidate the press.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is prepared to pursue American objectives even at the cost of friction with Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is of potential benefit to the United States if the United States can nurture a sense of common purpose and trust with Russia.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore and the Democratic Party will continue efforts to engage Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}

```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Russia's historic transition to a market democracy is difficult, all the more reason to continue to engage Russia.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Russian democracy is challenged by corruption that deeply penetrates her society, all the more reason to engage Russia on behalf of reform.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Russia has her own self-interest and concerns that can and do run contrary to ours, all the more reason to search for constructive forms of cooperation.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States deeply disagrees with what Russia is doing in Chechnya and remains concerned about signs of Russian efforts to intimidate the press, all the more reason to step up discussions with them on those issues.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party is prepared to pursue American objectives as needed even at the cost of friction with Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"It is of tremendous potential benefit to the United States if the United States can nurture a sense of common purpose and trust with Russia.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Al Gore and the Democratic Party will continue that effort to engage Russia.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
